# SDL3 (statically linked, trimmed down)
set(SDL_STATIC       ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_SHARED       OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_CAMERA       OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_RENDER       OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_GPU          OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_AUDIO        ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_SENSOR       OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_VULKAN       OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_OFFSCREEN    OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TESTS        OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_INSTALL      OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(SDL)

add_subdirectory(bgfx)
add_subdirectory(glm)
add_subdirectory(imgui)
add_subdirectory(rapidjson)
add_subdirectory(stb)
add_subdirectory(cmixer)
add_subdirectory(cgltf)
add_subdirectory(pugixml)
add_subdirectory(tracy)

cherrysoda_set_targets_folder("bgfx;bimg;bimg_decode;bx" External/bgfx)
cherrysoda_set_targets_folder("SDL3-static" External/SDL)
cherrysoda_set_targets_folder("imgui;stb_vorbis;cmixer;pugixml" External)
if(CHERRYSODA_BUILD_TESTS)
  add_subdirectory(gtest)
  cherrysoda_set_targets_folder("gmock;gmock_main;gtest;gtest_main" External/gtest)
endif()
if(CHERRYSODA_BUILD_SHADERC)
  cherrysoda_set_targets_folder("glslang;spirv-cross;spirv-opt;tint;shaderc" Tools/shaderc)
endif()
